headline: Howard's 15th-inning single walks off the Astros
recap: Ryan Howard drove in both Phillies runs and ended it in the bottom of the 15th, singling to right with two outs to score Grady Sizemore from second and beat the Houston Astros 2-1 at Citizens Bank Park. Howard had put Philadelphia in front in the second with a solo home run, his 17th of the season, and finished 2-for-6 with two RBI.

Kyle Kendrick went seven innings for the Phillies, allowing five hits and one run — a Jon Singleton RBI single in the seventh that tied it. Dallas Keuchel matched him with seven innings of one-run ball for Houston.

The bullpen made it stand up: seven Phillies relievers combined for eight scoreless innings and allowed one hit the rest of the way. Antonio Bastardo was the standout, striking out six over two hitless innings in the 11th and 12th. Héctor Neris worked a scoreless 15th to set up the winning rally.
